title: Judge Retry-vs-Escalate Response
description: Structured response from the retry-vs-escalate judge call site (#3 per spec §6.9). Fires before consuming the final retry to let the LLM decide whether one more attempt is worthwhile or whether escalation is the better path.

decision.description: 'retry' continues with the remaining attempt; 'escalate' transitions to BLOCKED with operator notification.

reasoning.description: Human-readable reasoning for why retry or escalation is the right call.
